title: Sienese envoys to the Priori and Capitano del Popolo of Siena, before 1429 (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 14, DECODE R4802)

steps.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858), missed by the 23 Sept scan; downloaded 131 images with the project cookie (the session that worked on all the Concistoro letters).
Viewed and indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (R4746-R4789); compared their alphabets by eye with this letter's signs: none fits.
No. 14 (R4802) transcribed by a subagent: ~1,300 tokens, 248 point-divided words; re-checked to split the sign OBAR into OL/OR/O after key work showed it stood for both d and m.
wordsolve.py (spaced it-cinquecento LM, order 4/5, 10 x 300k) on no. 14 without cribs: stuck on pseudo-Italian.

Hand crib on the recurring words '8 6 RR IB VB Q' = nostra/vostra, 'RR IB EQ IB 6' = stato, 'Y 6 RR IB VB' = vostr-: re-anneal gives Italian ('del nostro stato e dela nostra cita', 'considerano', 'carlo', 'toscana').
homsolve2.py (staged order 3->4 anneal, frequency-seeded restarts, swap moves) on no. 14 with NO crib reaches the same key and better score (-3991 on the corrected transcription).
No. 14 dating: Carlo Malatesta (1368-1429) alive; war of Tuscany with 'three powers' against <Z7>; not fixed (1409-14 or 1423-24 candidates).

Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 14 only. Fraction taken from the second reading pass (transcripts/no14_reading2.txt: 876 of 1,495 tokens in words read as sense); validation rerun on no. 14 alone.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 845 tokens, 35 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.153 per letter; random keys -3.953 (z 6.1); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.793 (mean -2.828, z 29.9); annealer on the real text -2.659. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.004; polyphony 0.043; 636 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.659

outcome.method_basis: homsolve2 (staged order 3->4 annealing, frequency-seeded restarts) reached the key with no crib, the same key a hand crib had pinned first.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no14_reading2.txt COUNT: 876 of 1,495 cipher tokens in words read as sense (58.6%); 436 doubtful (29.2%), 161 unread (10.8%), 22 code signs (1.5%).

gaps.item: doubtful and unread words (about 40% of 1,495 tokens) and the codes <7H>, <Z7>, (420)
gaps.detail: small signs at the DECODE resolution, mostly the first lines, lines 13-15 and the subscription; the key itself is recovered

outcome.notes: Sienese envoys (signed '...Marco', place Rome?) to the Priori and Capitano del Popolo, before 1429. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 14 only.

prior.where: Not in print or online (Meister 1902, Cecchini 1952, Senatore 2009 checked); the 1952 inventory calls the bundle 'solo parzialmente decifrate'

human: Set the goal (decipher the 29 letters; try the 42 filed keys first). Instructed that DECODE records marked Decrypted are to be trusted as read.
